sphere_commentary.overview:
Three distinct efficacy profiles align with design intent across series. HEALING demonstrates strongest consistency (std=1.77), THRIVING shows highest mean outcomes (mean=6.96), while TRANSFORMING exhibits greatest spread (std=1.87) — expected for its ascending-arc protocols.
• All series show outcome-score distributions consistent with 0–10 scale validation studies
• Bimodal response patterns appear in 6 protocols — warrants audience segmentation analysis
• Crisis protocols show appropriate lower scores given acute listener states on arrival
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
The three series show distinct efficacy profiles that reflect their design intent.
• HEALING leads in listener consistency, with the lowest variance across entry points
• THRIVING clusters at high mean but splits between high-clarity and low-maintenance subtypes
• TRANSFORMING carries widest variance — ASCENT mood/energy protocols underperform relative to DESCENT mind/clarity
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Several protocols show response patterns that diverge from design expectations.
• X-ME-L3 (Updraft): bimodal low/mid-affect split with 38.5% at score 7 and 20% at 9–10 — suggests population mismatch
• T-FC-L3 (Summit): AutoGluon routes to low-affect zones (focus 7.728) but cross-bucket matches mental clarity/motivation — zone violation flag
• H-CR-L1 (Anchor): 53% positive outcomes but 12% adviser referral rate — high clinician use may skew crisis protocol baseline
• X-MD-L2 (Trail): ASCENT motivation protocol underperforms (mean=6.21, 43% positive) with drop at 7–8 bracket
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Actionable protocol improvements based on signal convergence.
• Adjust Adviser routing for T-FC-L3 (n=35): AutoGluon cross-bucket suggests expanding to motivation/clarity zones despite Hold architecture
• Increase hold phase of H-SL-L3 (Midnight, n=28): 78% settling feedback at 5–10 min but design lacks extended theta maintenance
• Investigate bimodality in X-ME-L3 (n=18): Check split between low/mid-affect users (score 7 cluster) and high-affect outliers (9–10)
• Test L2 variant for X-MD-L2 (Trail, n=14): Shift baseline to theta-alpha wave range for first half to improve ASCENT entrainment
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding analysis reveals evolving signals in low-affiliation protocols and validated design logic for Hold-based focus protocols.
• CROSS-RUN DRIFT: Notable drift (mean_sim < 0.68) for 7 protocols — model sensitive to early-stage data, particularly X-MD-L3 (0.507) and H-SL-L1 (0.530)
• CROSS-PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: Hold-based focus/cognitive protocols cluster tightly (T-FC-L1↔L2 sim=0.878); TRANSFORMING ASCENT designs structurally isolated from other buckets
• Confidence note: Embedding data limited to single run history — drift signals indicate analytical instability in n<50 protocols, not true population shift
